script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying the bribe does its work quietly adds a detail the text does not give.
The explanation is generic and ends with a corrective instruction rather than Papa Dorin's warmth or personality.
Nothing happens until the report is known to be true overlooks the investigation Moses commands first.
Saying hard cases do not go to the closest town rules out a possibility the text leaves open. The place the LORD chooses could be closest.
The explanation is flat and repeats the answer without adding insight or personality.
It's not about the horses at all contradicts the verse's restrictions on acquiring horses and sending people to Egypt for them.
The text does not say that reading the scroll makes the king remember he is one of his brothers.
Calling the long reign a promise turns the stated purpose, that he and his sons may reign many years, into a guarantee.
